en.text: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—

zhSimplified.text: 作使徒的保罗（不是由于人，也不是借着人，乃是借着耶稣基督，与叫他从死里复活的父 神）

zhTraditional.text: 作使徒的保羅（不是由於人，也不是藉着人，乃是藉着耶穌基督，與叫他從死裏復活的父上帝）

en.text: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

footnotes.text: 1:2 The word for “brothers” here and where context allows may also be correctly translated “brothers and sisters” or “siblings.”

zhSimplified.text: 和一切与我同在的众弟兄，写信给加拉太的各教会。

zhTraditional.text: 和一切與我同在的眾弟兄，寫信給加拉太的各教會。

en.text: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

zhSimplified.text: 愿恩惠、平安从父 神与我们的主耶稣基督归与你们！

zhTraditional.text: 願恩惠、平安從父上帝與我們的主耶穌基督歸與你們！

en.text: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—

zhSimplified.text: 基督照我们父 神的旨意，为我们的罪舍己，要救我们脱离这罪恶的世代。

zhTraditional.text: 基督照我們父上帝的旨意，為我們的罪捨己，要救我們脫離這罪惡的世代。

en.text: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

zhSimplified.text: 但愿荣耀归于 神，直到永永远远。阿们！

zhTraditional.text: 但願榮耀歸於上帝，直到永永遠遠。阿們！

en.text: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,

zhSimplified.text: 我希奇你们这么快离开那借着基督之恩召你们的，去从别的福音。

zhTraditional.text: 我希奇你們這麼快離開那藉着基督之恩召你們的，去從別的福音。

en.text: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

zhSimplified.text: 那并不是福音，不过有些人搅扰你们，要把基督的福音更改了。

zhTraditional.text: 那並不是福音，不過有些人攪擾你們，要把基督的福音更改了。

en.text: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

zhSimplified.text: 但无论是我们，是天上来的使者，若传福音给你们，与我们所传给你们的不同，他就应当被咒诅。

zhTraditional.text: 但無論是我們，是天上來的使者，若傳福音給你們，與我們所傳給你們的不同，他就應當被咒詛。

en.text: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

zhSimplified.text: 我们已经说了，现在又说，若有人传福音给你们，与你们所领受的不同，他就应当被咒诅。

zhTraditional.text: 我們已經說了，現在又說，若有人傳福音給你們，與你們所領受的不同，他就應當被咒詛。

en.text: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.

zhSimplified.text: 我现在是要得人的心呢？还是要得 神的心呢？我岂是讨人的喜欢吗？若仍旧讨人的喜欢，我就不是基督的仆人了。

zhTraditional.text: 我現在是要得人的心呢？還是要得上帝的心呢？我豈是討人的喜歡嗎？若仍舊討人的喜歡，我就不是基督的僕人了。

en.text: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

zhSimplified.text: 弟兄们，我告诉你们，我素来所传的福音不是出于人的意思。

zhTraditional.text: 弟兄們，我告訴你們，我素來所傳的福音不是出於人的意思。

en.text: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

zhSimplified.text: 因为我不是从人领受的，也不是人教导我的，乃是从耶稣基督启示来的。

zhTraditional.text: 因為我不是從人領受的，也不是人教導我的，乃是從耶穌基督啟示來的。

en.text: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.

zhSimplified.text: 你们听见我从前在犹太教中所行的事，怎样极力逼迫残害 神的教会。

zhTraditional.text: 你們聽見我從前在猶太教中所行的事，怎樣極力逼迫殘害上帝的教會。

en.text: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

zhSimplified.text: 我又在犹太教中，比我本国许多同岁的人更有长进，为我祖宗的遗传更加热心。

zhTraditional.text: 我又在猶太教中，比我本國許多同歲的人更有長進，為我祖宗的遺傳更加熱心。

en.text: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,

zhSimplified.text: 然而，那把我从母腹里分别出来、又施恩召我的 神，

zhTraditional.text: 然而，那把我從母腹裏分別出來、又施恩召我的上帝，

en.text: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,

zhSimplified.text: 既然乐意将他儿子启示在我心里，叫我把他传在外邦人中，我就没有与属血气的人商量，

zhTraditional.text: 既然樂意將他兒子啟示在我心裏，叫我把他傳在外邦人中，我就沒有與屬血氣的人商量，

en.text: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

zhSimplified.text: 也没有上耶路撒冷去见那些比我先作使徒的，惟独往阿拉伯去，后又回到大马士革。

zhTraditional.text: 也沒有上耶路撒冷去見那些比我先作使徒的，惟獨往阿拉伯去，後又回到大馬士革。

en.text: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

zhSimplified.text: 过了三年，才上耶路撒冷去见矶法，和他同住了十五天。

zhTraditional.text: 過了三年，才上耶路撒冷去見磯法，和他同住了十五天。

en.text: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.

zhSimplified.text: 至于别的使徒，除了主的兄弟雅各，我都没有看见。

zhTraditional.text: 至於別的使徒，除了主的兄弟雅各，我都沒有看見。

en.text: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.

footnotes.text: 1:20 “Behold”, from “ἰδοὺ”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

zhSimplified.text: 我写给你们的不是谎话，这是我在 神面前说的。

zhTraditional.text: 我寫給你們的不是謊話，這是我在上帝面前說的。

en.text: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

zhSimplified.text: 以后我到了叙利亚和基利家境内。

zhTraditional.text: 以後我到了敘利亞和基利家境內。

en.text: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

zhSimplified.text: 那时，犹太信基督的各教会都没有见过我的面。

zhTraditional.text: 那時，猶太信基督的各教會都沒有見過我的面。

en.text: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”

zhSimplified.text: 不过听说那从前逼迫我们的，现在传扬他原先所残害的真道。

zhTraditional.text: 不過聽說那從前逼迫我們的，現在傳揚他原先所殘害的真道。

en.text: So they glorified God in me.

zhSimplified.text: 他们就为我的缘故，归荣耀给 神。

zhTraditional.text: 他們就為我的緣故，歸榮耀給上帝。
